subject: EV Charging and Residential Parking Regulations
overview: The Commission approved a new location for on-street EV charging stations, established resident permit parking on Pinkham Road, and granted several residential parking variances for residents on major thoroughfares.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 9, 2025, meeting.

items.title: 2025-65: On-Street EV Charging Stations
items.summary: Approved two on-street electric vehicle charging stations near 200 Boston Avenue as a compromise location to serve neighborhoods with limited off-street parking.

items.title: 2025-70: Parking Variance for 201 Riverside Ave
items.summary: Approved a parking variance allowing a resident to park on Ship Avenue due to insufficient on-site capacity and safety concerns regarding crossing Riverside Avenue at night.

items.title: 2025-71: Parking Variance for 292 Boston Ave
items.summary: Approved a parking variance for a resident to park on Piggott Road to address parking scarcity during street sweeping and late-night commuting.

items.title: 2025-72: Parking Variance for 343 Main Street
items.summary: Tabled the request because the petitioner was not present to speak to the item.

items.title: 2025-73: Parking Variance for 400 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a parking variance for a resident to park on Alexander Avenue after determining there was sufficient space on the street.

items.title: 2025-74: Pinkham Road Resident Permit Parking
items.summary: Approved a resident petition to implement 24/7 permit parking on Pinkham Road to mitigate overflow parking from Boston Avenue and commuter competition.

items.title: 2025-75: Visitor Parking Variance for 465 Broadway
items.summary: Denied a request for a visitor parking variance for an address on the Somerville border, citing existing precedents and nearby open parking options.

items.title: 2025-76: Lewis Street Parking Restriction
items.summary: Approved a no-parking restriction on the south side of Lewis Street for 25 feet from the Fulton Street corner to ensure emergency vehicle clearance.

items.title: 2025-77 & 78: High Street Safety Measures
items.summary: Approved daylighting parking restrictions at the High Street and Pitcher Avenue crosswalk and established a stop sign on Pitcher Avenue at High Street.

items.title: 2025-60: Handicap Sign Removal
items.summary: Referred the item to be placed on file following the death of the petitioner.
